title: DSAR export gains submitted_ip_text/submitted_user_agent/reference_contact_choice — outside Story RC1.1's Files/areas (judged justified Art. 15 fallout, not an AC violation)
evidence: Diff hunk server/src/dsar/dsar_handler.gleam: '+    #("submitted_ip_text", json.string(app.submitted_ip_text)),' / '+    #("submitted_user_agent", json.string(app.submitted_user_agent)),' / '+    #("reference_contact_choice", nullable_string(app.reference_contact_choice)),' — vs Story RC1.1 Files/areas (epics-reference-checking-v1-2026-07-30.md): '**Files/areas:** `supabase/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_*` (two migrations) · `server/src/application/application_handler.gleam` (`insert_acknowledgement_records`, ~1779; submission capture) · `server/src/application/sql.gleam` + `server/src/application/sql/` · `shared/src/shared/application.gleam` (new fields on the type + codecs)'
detail: Story Files/areas names only migrations, application_handler.gleam, sql.gleam + sql/, and shared/application.gleam — dsar/* is unrequested. Judgment: not compile-forced, but Art. 15 requires the subject's own new personal-data columns in the export; AD-11 restricts the 'landlord payload' only, so no constraint is breached.
recommended_fix: Keep the change; state the Art. 15 rationale explicitly in the PR's Decisions & rationale so the scope extension beyond the story's Files/areas is on record.
